data.one_liner: An awesome message widget and route similar to toast, snackbar, and prompt.
data.what_it_does: Provides an awesome message widget that can be embedded directly in a UI container or used as a custom Route via Navigator.push. It supports themes and multiple platforms like Android, iOS, web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
use_when: You want a custom toast or banner style notification rendered as a widget or route.
You need cross-platform message prompting matching a custom look and feel.
avoid_when: You need standard platform-native toasts without custom widget layouts.
You require complex push notification or local background notification handling.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including mobile, web, and desktop.
Can be used both as a standard Widget inside a tree or as a Navigator Route.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and examples beyond basic routing and widget creation.
Relies on manual Navigator routing rather than a built-in overlay manager like standard toasts.

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard, easy-to-use native toast messages across platforms.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need modern, highly customizable toast notifications with rich styling options.

alternatives.name: bot_toast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust toast solution that operates globally using overlays without context.
